name: RGB 4 color Remote Control Led Strip Light Complete Kit
description:
Size: 5 meter 
An RGB Waterproof Remote Control Color Changing LED Strip Light Complete Kit typically includes:
RGB LED Strips: Flexible, color-changing strips with Red, Green, and Blue LEDs.
Waterproof Design: Protects against moisture (IP65/IP67 rating), suitable for indoor and outdoor use.
Remote Control: Adjust colors, brightness, and lighting effects (flash, fade, etc.).
Power Supply: Adapter to convert AC to low-voltage DC for LEDs.
Connectors: To link strips together or extend the length.
